_source: Verbatim Thai i18n keys from pototype/pr-form.jsx PRForm (L223-546) — the DETAIL view of an existing PR. Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so no Thai literal appears in pr-form.tsx / pr-form-rows.ts / use-pr-form.ts — same pattern as pr-strings.json. navPr is the 'ใบขอซื้อ (PR)' nav_i18n label (tn, NAV-ROUTES.md L126). Every other value is a phrases key (tp) that has no dedicated dict key; the rest of the screen uses pr.form.* / common.* / vendor.* / boq.* / subcon.* / nav.sec.proc DICT keys via t(). typeSubconWo ('สั่งจ้าง (WO)') is the form's WO-typed tab label, DISTINCT from pr.list's typeSubcon ('สั่งจ้าง'). All values pre-verified present as phrases keys in i18n-full.json (zero mint). Glyph discipline: 'พิมพ์ความเห็น...' uses ASCII '...' (U+002E ×3) not '…'; priceMatchInfo uses em-dash U+2014; colAmount uses ฿ U+0E3F.
